outfit.name: 燕麦华夫格露肩针织衫与过膝袜
outfit.prose: A soft oatmeal-hued waffle-knit slouchy pullover with an extra-wide neckline falling off the collarbones, layered over grey ribbed boy-shorts. Worn with thigh-high charcoal heather wool socks that hug the thigh snugly, creating a cute soft indentation around the top edge, barefoot on carpet.
